Enrich person.name: Mike Pegnato
Enrich person.title: COO, Fidelity Personal Trust Company
Enrich person.summary:
Strategic product and platform executive with deep leadership across Alternatives (Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Hedge Strategies), SMA/UMA, ETFs, and third-party manager platforms. Proven track record leading complex global teams, owning end-to-end product lifecycle, and driving large-scale technology and platform modernization initiatives. 
Vast experience in vendor and platform management, risk and regulatory oversight, and delivering coordinated, cross-regional business strategies. Recognized for developing high-performing teams/BU's.

Consistent success commercializing products and services that now generate more than $XXM in recurring annual revenue.

Selected Highlights:
• Digital Assets: Built the business case and operating model for Fidelity’s Crypto IRA.
• ETFs: Led strategy, technology, and contracting for the first commission‑free ETF program for broker‑dealers; expanded the platform to 500+ ETFs. Developed the semi‑transparent active ETF program and designed the ETF Support Fee model to protect revenue.
• Alternatives: Digitized subscription and capital‑call processes; strengthened manager relationships with CAIS, iCapital, Goldman Sachs, and others.
• Technology: Created and commercialized the Prospectus Delivery System. Partnered with Fidelity’s AI COE on LLM‑based tools to summarize / score trust agreements. 
• Data & Analytics: Delivered predictive analytics solutions to help asset managers optimize RIA prospecting by asset class and product type.

Experience:
• (Present) COO, Fidelity Personal Trust Company: Leading modernization, integration, and scale of the Personal Trust business.
• (2022-2024) VP, Strategy & Incubation – Digital Assets: Identified and developed high‑impact opportunities to expand Fidelity’s digital asset offering (Crypto IRA, Pricing, Rewards).
• (2019-2022) VP, Head of Product, Technology & Strategy: Directed product, platform, and distribution strategy for 600+ third‑party asset managers across brokerage and recordkeeping platforms.
• (2017-2019) VP, Head of Fidelity Alternative Investments: Managed technology, product, services, partnerships, and asset manager relationships.
• (2007-2017) VP/Director Product Management (MF, Alts, Cash): Responsible for technology, product, P&L for funds, ETFs, and cash sweep.

Specialties: Revenue Growth & Cost Optimization, Platform Modernization, Mutual Fund/ETF/Alternatives Product Strategy, Wealth Platforms, Digital Assets, Regulatory Compliance (OCC, MSRB, SEC, FINRA), Data & Analytics, Enterprise Partnerships, Organizational Leadership.
